observable: H1 (linear chain response): identified from the 6 stored impulse responses (1,048,576 samples stored at 96 kHz, acquired from 48 kHz sweeps).
unobservable: h2[k,l] time-domain kernel values: require concurrent raw excitation and raw output records (none are stored; MeasData.ir=null, audioDataLength=0 in all 12 measurements).
complex H2 (magnitude AND phase) per harmonic: only magnitudes are stored (dBHarmonicData), no phase, so the complex quadratic transfer function cannot be formed.
separation of H2 from compression/AGC and level-dependent behavior: requires a level series (>=2 levels); the sweeps use -12 dBFS only and the stepped-sine runs -20 dBFS only.
intermodulation terms h2(f1,f2) at sum/difference frequencies: distortionData.isIMD=false and imddB placeholders are 0.0; no two-tone record exists.
identifiability.verdict: H2 is NOT identifiable from this dataset; H1 is. Any H2 loaded from this data would be fabricated.
